direct_appeal_read: A tightly cropped adult fashion photograph whose visual pull comes from the controlled waist-to-hip contour, restrained abdominal definition, warm luminous skin, and the stark central skin-against-black material contrast.

render_contract.perceptual_proposition: A face-excluding vertical torso-and-upper-thigh crop in which restrained natural body definition and warm skin are shaped by soft directional light and framed by matte black clothing and dark leather.

invariants.observation: The narrow 2:3 portrait is filled by the adult subject from cropped upper chest through upper thighs; the face and most shoulders remain outside the top, while both legs continue beyond the bottom.

invariants.observation: The visible adult body is slim and lightly toned, with a narrow waist, gentle outward transition into the hips and upper thighs, a shallow central abdominal line, and only restrained oblique definition.
